extracted.stage: Employment tribunal claim for unfair dismissal
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Kowalski Legal LLP asks whether funding of £40,000 for disbursements and counsel is available for a client's unfair dismissal employment tribunal claim.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details provided so far. So that we can consider it properly, we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the claim is proceeding, the stage of the tribunal proceedings and any listed hearing dates, and the basis on which the claim is valued. It would also help to know what security, if any, could be offered in support of the funding requested. Please note our products are focused on family law and probate matters, so we will review whether this enquiry falls within our scope. We will come back to you once we have reviewed the information.
